improvements.rationale: These meta tags address three critical gaps: 1) The meta description targets high-intent search queries like 'AI business assistant' and 'trade assistant' while clearly communicating the free trial offer to boost click-through rates. 2) Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the page is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or other platforms—essential for a B2B audience. 3) Twitter card tags optimize sharing on X/Twitter. All copy stays factual, mentions the three free searches as a low-friction CTA, and reinforces the Claude-powered credibility without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business professionals. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product by name and clarifies its purpose, building trust and recognition. The subheading highlights three concrete benefits (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) that align with stated value props, while the free trial CTA reduces friction and encourages immediate engagement. Copy is concise, avoids unverified claims, and speaks directly to the target audience of traders and business owners.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free trial to paid membership and reinforcing the low entry price and value, it reduces uncertainty and helps move prospects toward signup.
